A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-18: the owner asked (via borg-reborn-rs, borg-zoo#235) for a pilot of the #539 fleeing switches, five arms. retain_evidence was added by the zoo session: the gate and endpoints count notes and Recall reads in every game, not only in deaths.
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-18, before any result was read (borg-zoo#235). Pilot (RULES 14, 16); small and larger only after
this gate and the owner. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's borg.txt has its three switch values and
params-core.json reports them; no plan loaded; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn
bursts classified and key outliers listed; death bundles reproduced; in ctl no "# No stairs: fighting at range
on Scaryguy Level." and no "# No Phase: no monster next to me" note in any game's messages. Report per arm and
per class: deaths and causes, final level, deepest level; Recall and Deep Descent reads per game (stairs against
ctl), and deaths with a staircase in reach while Recall was active where the messages show it; "# No Phase"
notes per game, and deaths within 20 thinks of a skipped Phase Door; "# No stairs: fighting at range" notes per
game, and the ranged attacks that followed them; scary-level deaths per arm; paired rescued and newly killed
against ctl. "all" is the shipped default. 18 starts per arm show direction only.
